rows.text: Published a post on Morgan's linkedin account. It read: "I'm excited to announce Halcyon Threshold, a new initiative focused on contributing to positive superintelligent AI outcomes. As AI capabilities rapidly advance—with each generation of systems better at building the next—we stand at a threshold between two possible futures. One leads to unprecedented flourishing; the other to catastrophe. The difference comes down to whether we solve the alignment and coordination challenges. Halcyon Threshold exists to contribute through: • Rigorous analysis and synthesis • Accessible frameworks for thinking about AI outcomes • Mapping the landscape of actors and initiatives • Constructive discourse on critical questions • Bridging technical, policy, and public conversations We're starting with: ✓ A comprehensive knowledge base on key concepts ✓ The first essay: \"The Threshold Moment\" on where we stand ✓ Frameworks like the AI Outcomes Matrix ✓ Ongoing analysis and commentary The next few years are critical. We have a narrow window where we can still shape the trajectory, where problems are tractable, where we can choose cooperation over competition. We need more people engaged with these questions—not from fear or hype, but from clear thinking about what's at stake and what success looks like. Visit: https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app Looking forward to contributing to this crucial work and engaging with others working on these challenges. #AI #AIAlignment #AIGovernance #Superintelligence #TechEthics"

rows.text: Published a post on Morgan's bluesky account. It read: "Launching Halcyon Threshold - a new project focused on positive superintelligent AI outcomes. We stand at a threshold between two possible futures. The path we take depends on solving alignment (making AI systems robustly beneficial) and coordination (global cooperation on safe development). Starting with: • The Threshold Moment essay on where we stand • Knowledge base on key concepts • Frameworks for thinking about outcomes • Ongoing analysis and discourse The next few years are critical. We have time to get this right—not unlimited time, but some. We need more people thinking clearly about these questions. halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app The halcyon future is possible. Let's build it together."
